# Sound effects

These short, original PCM WAV cues are available for optional UI feedback:

- `ready.wav` — gentle two-note ready cue.
- `send.wav` — short rising send cue.
- `success.wav` — soft three-note confirmation.
- `error.wav` — low two-note warning.

Each file is mono 16-bit PCM at 22,050 Hz. They are not played automatically
by the native app, so using the assets does not introduce unexpected sound.
Sound playback can be added as an explicit user preference if desired.
